body.p: Applicant replies to the final Office Action dated August 5, 2022, in which this Reply is filed within two months. Claims 1-9, 11-12, and 14-21 stand rejected. Reconsideration is respectfully requested.

Applicant thanks the Examiner for the indication that claim 10 would be allowable if rewritten in independent form. Applicant presently amends claim 1 to recite the features of claim 10 (and cancels claim 10). Applicant further amends independent claims 11 and 17 to recite features of claim 10. Accordingly, independent claims 1, 11, and 17, and their respective dependent claims, are allowable.

Claims 1-5, 7, 8, 11, and 12 are rejected under 102 as being anticipated by U.S. Patent No. 6,315,079 (Berends). Applicant respectfully disagrees with the rejection, but nevertheless amends the claims to facilitate expeditious prosecution.

Applicant herein amends independent claim 1 to recite the allowable subject matter of claim 10. Accordingly, as recognized in the Office Action, none of the cited references disclose or even contemplate these features, and thus Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of this rejection of claim 1.

Applicant herein similarly amends independent claim 11 to recite features of claim 10. Accordingly, Applicant submits that independent claim 11 is allowable for the same or similar reasons as claim 1, and thus Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of this rejection of claim 11.

Claims 2-5, 7, 8, and 12, being dependent upon base claims 1 or 11, are also not anticipated by Berends for at least the same reasons as for claims 1 and 11, as well as in view of the additional features recited in claims 2-5, 7, 8, and 12. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of this rejection of claims 2-5, 7, 8, and 12. Rejections under Q 103
Claims 17-21 are rejected under 103 as being unpatentable over Berends. Applicant respectfully disagrees with this rejection, but nevertheless amends the claims to facilitate expeditious prosecution.

Applicant herein amends independent claim 17 to recite the allowable subject matter of claim 10. Accordingly, none of the cited references disclose or even contemplate these features, and thus Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of this rejection of claim 17.

Based upon the foregoing, claims 1, 11, and 17 are allowable over Berends. All claims that depend from claim 1, 11, or 17 are thereby also allowable over Berends for the above-noted reasons. There is therefore no need to separately address the patentability of each of these claims and/or the Patent Office's interpretation in relation to any of these claims or any of the references of record in relation thereto.

In view of the above remarks, Applicant respectfully submits that all pending claims are allowable and requests allowance of the pending claims. The Examiner is invited to telephone the undersigned at the Examiner's convenience, if that would help further prosecution of the subject application. Applicant authorizes and respectfully request that any fees due or overpayments be charged or credited to Deposit Account No. 19-2814. This statement does NOT authorize payment of the issue fee.
